tools.name: get_supported_languages
tools.description: Returns the current source-language list with harvester metadata. Call instead of hardcoding language names — spares the integrator a silent failure when the supported set grows in a later version. WHEN NOT TO USE: do not call on every generate_wiki invocation; cache the result. Returns languages[]

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: Returns the current status of an async wiki generation job. Call after generate_wiki with async=true; spares the calling agent or CI pipeline a blocking wait while a large module renders. WHEN NOT TO USE: do not poll for synchronous results — omit async=true on generate_wiki instead. Returns job_id,

tools.name: generate_wiki
tools.description: Generates wiki docs — parameters, risk posture, Markdown pages — from source code; eliminates documentation drift that costs engineers hours per sprint. Use when a module ships undocumented or its docs lag. WHEN NOT TO USE: snippets under 5 lines; files with no public functions. Languages: PowerShel
